title: The Latest Crier for Feb 23, 2026
items:
Late Night Central Art Event: Altered Books | Friday, Feb. 27 | 8-10pm | Maytag

Friday, February 27 | 8-10pm | Maytag Student Center 
All students are welcome to join us for this one-of-a-kind special Late Night Central event. Mary Robertson will guide us through an art project called Altered Books. This is a visual storytelling medium that allows you to explore and engage with the diverse world of arts and culture. Taking inspiration from underrepresented artists and influenced by graffiti and textured collages, we will have fun, create art, and tell stories by exploring the process of Altered Books.

The Leprechaun’s Heist: Escape the Room

A leprechaun has swiped your gold—do you have what it takes to get it back? Gather a team of up to four for a high-stakes, 30-minute race against the clock. Solve riddles, crack codes, and outwit the luck of the Irish! 

Date: Sunday, March 1 

Time: 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM (Arrive 10 minutes early) 

Location: BMW Rooms 

The fastest team wins a grand prize and campus-wide bragging rights. Spots are limited—sign up now! (must use central email in order to sign up)
